title: Derived Hecke algebra and cohomology of arithmetic groups
note: arXiv:1608.07234. PDF library/arxiv-1608.07234v3/1608.07234v3.pdf (ingested 2026-09-05, owner upload 783c4cf4). A graded extension of the Hecke algebra acting on cohomology of arithmetic groups; the structural idea only — degree 0 is the classical algebra and the extra degrees act on what it cannot see.
